places.name: Woodstock Square
places.connection: The town square was used as the central setting of Punxsutawney, where many key scenes were filmed.

places.name: Royal Victorian Manor
places.connection: This location served as the 'Cherry Street Inn' where Phil Connors stayed.

places.name: Old Courthouse Arts Center
places.connection: Used as the interior of the Pennsylvania Hotel in the film.

places.name: Woodstock Opera House
places.connection: The location where Phil Connors jumped from the bell tower in one of the scenes.
